name: mdm-editor
description: Editor for .mdm files: Markdown, equations and music scores in one rendered, editable document.

mdm.theme.description: MDM editor theme. 'auto' follows the VS Code theme; 'light', 'dark' and 'white' are the editor's own looks, painted by the palettes the extension bakes in whatever VS Code is wearing, 'white' being the light one on a sheet of white paper with the code keeping its slate. The name of any installed colour theme ('Monokai', 'Solarized Light', ...) picks that theme's syntax colours and its side. A name nobody contributes falls back to 'auto'. The toolbar lists them all.

enumDescriptions: Staff lines in gray, Guitar Pro style, so the notes stand out.
Staff lines in the same colour as the notes.
mdm.staffLines.description: Colour of the five staff lines in rendered scores.

enumDescriptions: No background: the score blends into the document, the way an equation does.
Brass tint, matching the MDM icon.
mdm.scoreFill.description: Fill drawn behind rendered scores. Every option carries a light and a dark value, and the one matching the active theme is used.

enumDescriptions: Scores are centred across the pane, the way display maths is.
Scores start at the left edge of the text.
mdm.scoreAlign.description: Where a rendered score sits across the pane. Only scores narrower than the pane are affected; a full-width one fills the line either way.

enumDescriptions: The YAML header is not shown. It stays on the file and is spliced back on every save.
The YAML header is the first block of the document and is edited in place.
mdm.frontMatter.description: Whether the YAML header is part of the document in the editor. Shown, it is an ordinary block: what is typed in it goes to the file, and deleting it deletes it from the file.

enumDescriptions: The outline panel is open down the left edge, listing the headings.
mdm.outline.description: Whether the outline panel is open. The toolbar button on the left of the bar writes it, so a document reopens with the panel it was left with.

mdm.outlineWidth.description: Width of the outline panel in pixels, as the grip beside it was last dragged to. The editor keeps a column of its own, so a panel wider than the pane allows is narrowed to fit while it is open.

enumDescriptions: Ctrl+D walks whole words, the way VS Code does: a caret in 'score' steps over 'scores'.
Ctrl+D walks every run of the text, inside words too: 'score' also lands in 'scores'.
mdm.multicursorMatch.description: What Ctrl+D (select next occurrence) matches. The toolbar toggle writes it.

enumDescriptions: The page keeps up with the tune: it keeps the staff system that is sounding whole on screen, moving only when part of that band would leave it.
The page is the reader's: a tune plays on wherever it is and nothing scrolls, so a long score can sound while the document is read.
mdm.followMusic.description: Whether the page follows a sounding tune. The toolbar toggle writes it.
